sections.h2: Only 14% of the 11,201 filed applications were marked eligible

chart.title: Only 358 of 11,201 filed applications have been disbursed
chart.sub: Applications at each stage of the AHIDF portal, count.
chart.source: AHIDF live dashboard (SIDBI/Udyami Mitra), updated 10 August 2026.

sections.means: The portal's counters show the pipeline narrowing at each stage, from 11,201 filed to 358 disbursed.
sections.todo: Publish average sanction-to-first-disbursement times so readers can separate normal construction lag from stuck applications.

sections.h2: Only 39% of sanctioned loan value has been disbursed

chart.title: ₹7,770.4 crore of ₹19,750.8 crore sanctioned has been disbursed
chart.sub: Loan amount, ₹ crore, as on the portal's 10 August 2026 update.
chart.source: AHIDF live dashboard (SIDBI/Udyami Mitra), updated 10 August 2026.

sections.means: Most sanctioned value had not been disbursed at the snapshot date, and the dashboard cannot say how much of that is normal lag.
sections.todo: Report disbursed and undisbursed value by sanction year so the construction lag can be measured rather than assumed.

sections.h2: Maharashtra accounts for the largest share of applications filed

chart.title: Maharashtra leads with 2,261 applications, ahead of Uttar Pradesh's 1,490
chart.sub: Applications filed on the portal, by state, count.
chart.source: AHIDF live dashboard (SIDBI/Udyami Mitra), updated 10 August 2026.

sections.means: Maharashtra's 2,261 applications lead the state counts, but the dashboard is a live snapshot that can shift.
sections.todo: Re-run the state and district counts on a fixed date and keep a revision history, so changes can be tracked.
